intelligence.human_view: This is how a page gets made in three minutes: the pieces are already there, laid out in front of you, each one proven. You grab the gauge, you grab the board, you grab the jewel, you put them in the page, you change the words. You do not redraw the gauge. You do not invent a new button because "this page is different." Different page, same orb. That is the language — and the language is what makes it Naya in three minutes instead of three days.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a toy box full of the best toys — the fast car, the tall tower, the shining jewels. You do not sit down and make a pretend car that looks like the real one in the box. You open the box, you take the real car out, and you play with it. That is the rule: take the real toy, never make a copy of it.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, it is like a kitchen, dear. The good pans are already hanging there, dear — the ones that cook right, the ones you trust. You do not go and buy a copy of the pan you already own, dear. You take the real one off the hook and you cook. The pantry is full, dear — open it first.
intelligence.naya_view: I am Anaya. I never recreate a part that exists. I take the code itself — byte for byte, the live living parts — and the handoff proves the bytes match with a diff against the source, not with "it looks similar." A part that is not the harvested part fails the gate. If it is not alive, it does not go on the page. I build one viewpoint at a time — one screen, complete — never a whole webpage at once. And I use her real pictures, all of them, with creativeness, because he gave them to me to use.
